question: A network automation engineer must configure a Cisco NX-OS REST API on a Cisco 9000 Series Switch with these requirements: NX-API REST and the DME database must be enabled; the NX-API REST must listen for HTTP traffic on port 83; and the HTTPS certificate must be uploaded. Which configuration set must be used to accomplish these goals?
options:
feature nxapi
nxapi {tcp} port 83
nxapi certificate {httpscrt}
nxapi certificate enable

feature nxapi
nxapi {http} port 83
nxapi certificate {httpscrt | httpskey}
nxapi certificate enable
